claims.statement: The exact finite carriers Fin n -> Q with the rational inner product form a tower under zero padding: pad is functorial, Q-linear, injective and inner-product preserving
claims.where: HilbertLiftFiniteTower.lean::pad_refl, pad_trans, pad_add, pad_smul, pad_injective, finInner_pad

claims.statement: The finitely supported rational sequences N ->0 Q carry canonical injections ofFin with the cocone identity ofFin (pad h x) = ofFin x, every exact sequence is ofFin of some finite stage, and trunc is a left inverse
qinner is symmetric, bilinear, positive definite, restricts to finInner on the stages, and satisfies Cauchy-Schwarz and the arithmetic-quadratic bound over Q

l2, l1 and sup Cauchy conditions with rational tolerances; l1-Cauchy implies l2-Cauchy implies sup-Cauchy; l2-Cauchy is equivalent to the existence of an explicit modulus; doubling triangle inequality for squared distances

h_N = sum_{i<N} e_i/(i+1) is l2-Cauchy with modulus k -> k+1 (sqdist (h_m) (h_n) < 1/n for 1 <= n <= m), is not l1-Cauchy (l1dist (h_2n) (h_n) >= 1/2), and converges to no exact vector (sqdist (h_N) f >= 1/(M+1)^2 beyond the support bound M of f)
For RCLike k the finitely supported k-sequences carry the inner product sum conj(f i) g i, conjugate-symmetric, sesquilinear, positive definite
HilbertLiftSpace k := UniformSpace.Completion (N ->0 k) is a complete inner product space over k (Mathlib instances)

lift k : (N ->0 Q) -> HilbertLiftSpace k and liftFin are additive, Q-homogeneous, injective, inner-product preserving (inner (lift f) (lift g) = qinner f g), compatible with padding, and dist (lift f) (lift g)^2 = sqdist f g
claims.where: HilbertLiftCompletion.lean::inner_lift, inner_liftFin, liftFin_pad, lift_injective, dist_lift_sq, lift_add, lift_smul

claims.statement: A sequence of exact vectors is Cauchy in the lift if and only if it is l2-Cauchy with rational tolerances; convergence to an exact vector in the lift is TendsToL2
Every l2-Cauchy sequence of exact vectors has a unique limit in the lift

Over R the exact carrier is dense in the pre-Hilbert carrier and in the lift; every element of the real lift is the limit of an l2-Cauchy exact sequence; continuous maps out of the real lift are determined by their values on exact vectors
The real lift is strictly larger than the exact carrier: the limit of the harmonic witness is not an exact vector

Over C the Gaussian-rational pairs a + ib embed with the exact identity inner (a+ib) (c+id) = (qinner a c + qinner b d) + i (qinner a d - qinner b c), are dense in the complex lift, and the lift is strictly larger than the Gaussian-rational carrier

Exact rational replay of the tower, colimit, Cauchy-Schwarz, doubling triangle, rational-tolerance Cauchy conditions, harmonic witness bounds, modulus-based completion points with an inner-product fluctuation bound, the quantitative density step, and mutation controls

(qinner xm ym - qinner xn yn)^2 <= 2 (sqdist xm xn * qinner ym ym + qinner xn xn * sqdist ym yn)
UniformSpace.Completion of the exact carrier with the intrinsic rational l2 uniformity is uniformly isomorphic to HilbertLiftSpace R
HilbertLiftSpace k is isometrically isomorphic to lp (fun _ => k) 2
